tools.name: search_stocks
tools.description: Find US-listed companies Ryufin covers by ticker or company name. Returns ticker, name, sector, market value and the Ryufin page.

tools.name: get_stock_overview
tools.description: Price, market value, P/E, returns, sector and what the company says it does, verbatim from its latest annual report.

tools.name: get_financial_history
tools.description: A reported financial series for one stock from its SEC filings, trailing twelve months or single quarters, newest last. Metrics: pe, revenue, net_income, eps, gross_margin, op_margin, net_margin, roe, roa, roic, fcf.

tools.name: get_company_news
tools.description: The company's own recent current reports (8-K), newest first: the date, what kind of event, the company's own sentence and a link to the filing on sec.gov.

findings.title: Tool removed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_stock_answers" is no longer advertised. Removal can precede a shadowing replacement from another server.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_stock_overview" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Price, market value, P/E, returns, sector, RyuScore (0 to 100 from seven weighted criteria) and what the company says it does, verbatim from its latest annual report." → after: "Price, market value, P/E, returns, sector and what the company says it does, verbatim from its latest annual report."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
